description: This file defines the ExecSystemRunCommandValidator, an enumeration with associated methods for validating and resolving shell commands and their raw string representations, handling environment manipulations, shell wrappers, inline commands, and command parsing logic within an execution system.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Validates and resolves a command array and raw command string into a ValidationResult, constructing a ResolvedCommand if valid.

methods.name: allowlistEvaluationRawCommand
methods.description: Checks if the raw command string can be evaluated against the command array, considering shell wrappers.

methods.name: normalizeRaw
methods.description: Trims and normalizes the raw command string, returning nil if empty.

methods.name: trimmedNonEmpty
methods.description: Returns a trimmed version of the input string if non-empty; otherwise nil.

methods.name: allowlistEvaluationRawCommand
methods.description: Handles the logic for returning the normalized raw command based on shell wrapper context.

methods.name: normalizeExecutableToken
methods.description: Converts an executable token to lowercase basename, removing '.exe' extensions if present.

methods.name: isEnvAssignment
methods.description: Detects if a token is an environment variable assignment.

methods.name: hasEnvInlineValuePrefix
methods.description: Checks if a token has an inline environment value prefix.

methods.name: unwrapEnvInvocationWithMetadata
methods.description: Unwraps environment invocation commands, returning argv and usage of modifiers.

methods.name: unwrapShellMultiplexerInvocation
methods.description: Unwraps shell multiplexers like busybox or toybox to get the inner command.

methods.name: hasEnvManipulationBeforeShellWrapper
methods.description: Determines if environment manipulation occurs before shell wrapper in command argv.

methods.name: hasTrailingPositionalArgvAfterInlineCommand
methods.description: Checks if command argv contains positional arguments after inline commands.

methods.name: unwrapShellWrapperArgv
methods.description: Recursively unwraps shell wrapper commands to get their inner argv.

methods.name: findInlineCommandTokenMatch
methods.description: Finds inline command flags and their positions in argv.

methods.name: resolveInlineCommandTokenIndex
methods.description: Resolves the index of the inline command token in argv.

methods.name: combinedCommandInlineOffset
methods.description: Detects combined inline command flags like '-c' or '/c' within a token.

methods.name: extractShellInlinePayload
methods.description: Extracts the inline command payload based on the shell wrapper type.

methods.name: extractInlineCommandByFlags
methods.description: Extracts inline command string from argv using specific flags.

methods.name: extractCmdInlineCommand
methods.description: Extracts inline command payload from Windows cmd shell commands.
